chat: Discussion: [Kevin]: While Dave and Alice’s mutual vouch is solid, we still need Macroon, Mona, and Nina to confirm their exact tasks before leaving Admin, since I tracked them heading to Storage where I’m finishing wiring, and Bob to Electrical, so let's get their verified alibis now to pinpoint who was actually in the room when Judy was killed.

chat: Discussion: [Nina]: [I was in Admin until Round 3 before heading to Storage to finish my wiring task, but since Kevin only inferred our exit rather than witnessing it, let’s stop guessing and have everyone who was in Admin around the kill post their exact step-by-step movements so we can cross-check timelines and isolate the impostor.]

chat: Discussion: [Mona]: I was in Admin during Round 3 and saw Macroon cleaning the floor there, so I can confirm his exact location, but Kevin, since Liam and Nina pointed out your tracking was just an inference, please clarify your exact path and task progress so we can cross-check the timeline and isolate the impostor.

chat: Discussion: [Macroon]: I was cleaning the floor in Admin during Round 3 before moving to Storage, and I fully agree we need concrete visual alibis rather than inferences, so let's cross-check everyone's exact step-by-step movements—including Bob's verified path from Admin to Storage to Electrical—and Kevin, did you actually see anyone enter Admin right before the kill or were you just tracking from a distance?

chat: Discussion: [Bob]: I can confirm my exact timeline: I was in Admin during Round 2 with Nina and Macroon, moved to Storage in Round 3, and just arrived alone in Electrical in Round 5, so Kevin, please clarify if you actually saw Macroon, Mona, and Nina enter Storage or if you were just guessing based on their previous movements?

chat: Discussion: [Dave]: I agree with Bob and Nina that we need concrete visual evidence, so Kevin, why are you so focused on tracking everyone's inferences instead of just stating your own exact path?

chat: Discussion: [Alice]: I agree with Dave; Kevin seems very focused on where everyone else is moving rather than just explaining his own path clearly, and since Bob just said he only arrived in Electrical in Round 5, why is there a discrepancy in Kevin's timeline?
